# megaport_dci (Resource)

Data Centre Interconnect (DCI) Resource for the Megaport Terraform Provider. A DCI is a Port at each of two locations and a VXC between them, ordered, priced and billed as one item. This resource orders a DCI and reads it. Changing or destroying a DCI with Terraform is not supported yet: change or cancel it in the Megaport Portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "megaport_dci" "dci" {
  name                 = "Megaport DCI Example"
  a_end_location_id    = 6
  b_end_location_id    = 3
  speed                = 10000
  contract_term_months = 12
  auto_renew           = true
  cost_centre          = "Megaport DCI Example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `a_end_location_id` (Number) The numeric location ID of the A-End Port. This value can be retrieved from the data source megaport_location.
- `b_end_location_id` (Number) The numeric location ID of the B-End Port. This value can be retrieved from the data source megaport_location.
- `contract_term_months` (Number) The term of the contract in months. When the term ends without auto-renew, the DCI moves to a month-to-month term, and this attribute keeps the term that was ordered.
- `name` (String) The name of the DCI. Both Ports and the VXC are ordered with this name.
- `speed` (Number) The speed of the DCI in Mbps. Both Ports and the VXC are ordered at this speed, and both locations must offer it.

### Optional

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether the term renews when it ends. Defaults to false.
- `cost_centre` (String) A customer reference number to be included in billing information and invoices. Also known as the service level reference (SLR) number.

### Read-Only

- `a_end_port_uid` (String) The unique identifier of the A-End Port.
- `b_end_port_uid` (String) The unique identifier of the B-End Port.
- `provisioning_status` (String) The provisioning status of the DCI, rolled up from its Ports and VXC.
- `solution_uid` (String) The unique identifier of the DCI.
- `vxc_uid` (String) The unique identifier of the VXC between the two Ports.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A DCI can be imported by specifying the Solution UID.
terraform import megaport_dci.example "<SOLUTION_UID>"
```
